name: Hsin Sin Textile Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in Taipei City, Taiwan, Hsin Sin Textile Co., Ltd. specializes in the production and sale of polyester drawn textured yarns for the Taiwanese market, operating under its Yu Shan Long brand. Its extensive product catalog encompasses various specialized yarns, including wooly stretch, set, air entangling, high count, high stretch, non-torque, microfiber, modified polyester, thick and thin, color textured, single discat, soft package microfiber, and wormy yarns. Additionally, the company provides a range of other yarn types such as rainbow, CD wool-like, black and white two-tone, shrinkage, foy moy two-tone, two-tone thick and thin, dope dyed multi-color, and compound spandex cover yarns. The firm was established in 1980.
